p1: Normal first screen repeats verdict and default route across pulse, route and patrol.
Full-width white sections and borders create an administrative field-wall visual grammar.
Incident scenes remain too structurally isomorphic instead of having distinct task rhythms.
Resource and interface rows lack fast comparison and a clear current focus.
Fleet has no visible scope, comparison or risk distribution.
Tablet is phone modules arranged in columns with large unused space.
Short landscape becomes a miniature desktop split layout.
Overview, workspace, detail and connection do not yet share one mobile product language.
p2: Floating navigation remains visually heavy on short phones.
Device metadata consumes excess height at 320px.
Detail exposes too many unavailable fields before raw evidence.
Real-device motion and touch feel remain unverified.
The traffic chart dominates actionable objects.
requiredActions: Remove first-screen repetition and establish one mobile visual mainline.
Create scene-specific mobile task structures and comparison primitives.
Replace tablet and landscape desktop-like compositions.
Unify product-level mobile typography, object headers, state markers and grouped lists.
